stages.name: Lovable Felynes
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to a Trading Post, order acquisition efficiency <@cc.vup>+5%</>, order limit <@cc.vup>+2</>, plus an additional order acquisition efficiency <@cc.vup>+3%</> for every <$cc.bd_felyne><@cc.rem>Felvine</></>

stages.name: Trusty Buddies
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to a Factory, capacity limit <@cc.vup>+8</>, Productivity <@cc.vup>+5%</>, plus an additional Productivity <@cc.vup>+1%</> for every <$cc.bd_felyne><@cc.rem>Felvine</></>

stages.name: Felyne Lottery Bomb I
stages.description: Attacks detonate after a delay, with one of the following random effects: Deals 200% Physical Damage / Puts the target to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> for 1 second / <$ba.stun>Stuns</> the target for 0.1 seconds / Nothing happens at all! Talent deactivates after triggering Damage effect 3 times
